decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The new access from Chiswick High Road to the upper floors of the building,
which provides access to the existing residential accommodation, shall only
serve the ancillary residential accommodation for staff of the Public House
and shall not be used to provide entry to independent self-contained
accommodation.

Condition : 6 - The doors to the public house fronting Thornton Avenue shall only be used as an emergency exit and shall not be used as an entrance to the premises. The door shall be labelled "emergency exit only".
Condition : 7 - The gate from the beer garden to the rear of the public house shall be closed and not used as an entrance to the site. It shall only be used as a means of emergency exit.
Condition : 8 - The doors between the public house and beer garden to the rear shall be self-closing.

Condition : 10 - Informative:

1. It is expected that during the construction of the approved work no materials or equipment should interfere with the use of the pathway by members of the public. You are advised that you should contact the Council's Highways licensing department on 020 8583 4863.

2. Nothing in the planning permission hereby granted shall authorise the amendment of the existing approved opening hours or the existing entrances to the Public House.
description: Internal alterations, installation of a new entrance to existing accommodation on 1st and 2nd floors, erection of new flat roof extension to rear of building to public house, and relocation of air conditioning units
